notes: North is up. Bare printed names kept bare: HOFFNER, POWERS, ELMORE, BORDEN, TOWNSEND; Sylvan, Edgewood and Llewellyn are printed AV. Hoffner is printed 25' (measured 24.4 ft) and nothing leaves its north side, so the four avenues end there (T's). Powers (50') runs through from the west edge to sheet 614. Borden is printed 50' at Hoffner and 45' at Powers and Elmore (west line moves east ~50 px going south; measured 51 ft north of Powers, 45 ft south of it). Townsend comes in from sheet 614 at the right edge (label at the edge, faces y 5467/5715, ~41 ft, width not printed here) and stops at Borden (T). Elmore: only its north line is drawn (y ~7394 at the west edge to ~7362 at the east); centre taken 25 ft (151 px) south of it, which matches the water pipe. Edgewood, Llewellyn and Borden continue south of Elmore on sheets 609/610 (key map), so those are crosses; the key map shows no street south of Elmore at Sylvan, so Elmore/Sylvan is recorded as T (not visible on this sheet). The blocks west of Sylvan run to the west edge (lots 1931/1928 on Hoffner, Powers and Elmore); Runnymede is not on this sheet. The N-S faces drift ~+50 px eastward from top to bottom (sheet slightly rotated). Circled numbers are grade elevations. Scale ~6.04 px/ft.
